changes.question: For the Hawaii ERS 2017 PE RFP notice and 2022 PE RFP, SBCERS 2020 PE RFP, TRS Illinois FY25 PE RFP, Baltimore BCERS alternatives RFP, and Missouri LAGERS private-markets RFP, what minimum experience is required of the primary/lead consultant or, for SBCERS, at least one key professional assigned to the account?
changes.gold_answer: Hawaii ERS 2017 PE notice: at least seven years of domestic and international investment consulting/management experience with public pension plans. Hawaii ERS 2022 PE RFP: at least seven years providing domestic and international private equity/debt consulting to public pension plans. SBCERS 2020: at least one key assigned professional has ten years recommending institutional PE investment programs, including three years with the current firm; this is not expressly a lead-only rule. TRS Illinois FY25: the primary consultant has at least three years of PE consulting to public/private pension funds or other highly comparable relevant experience. Baltimore BCERS: primary consultant at least five years of DB public-pension consulting and three years with the firm. Missouri LAGERS: lead consultant at least five years in a lead role recommending private-market investments to US public pension funds.

note: Define the six intended source solicitations, distinguish lead consultant from SBCERS key professional, and include TRS comparable-experience alternative. Source clauses checked in original-derived texts.

changes.question: Across these ten general investment consulting RFPs in the corpus—OCERS, COAERS, SDCERS, Grand Rapids, CTA Retirement Plan, SC RSIC, Hartford MERF, SBCERA, NYC BERS and Boston BRS—what is the most common stated minimum number of years in business or experience for the consulting firm?
changes.gold_answer: Five years. Among the general-consulting RFPs with a firm-level years threshold, four state five years (OCERS, COAERS, SDCERS and Grand Rapids), three state ten years (CTA, SC RSIC and Hartford MERF), two state seven years (SBCERA and NYC BERS), and one states three years (Boston BRS). COAERS allows firms younger than five years when senior principals meet its ten-year experience alternative.

note: Five years is supported, but original full-corpus counts were under-scoped. Explicitly name the ten general-consultant RFPs being counted so the modal statistic has a reproducible denominator.

changes.question: What are all the minimum requirements in Section 2 (pages 4–5) of the City of Hartford MERF general investment consultant RFP?
changes.gold_answer: Section2 requires: (1) at least ten years providing general consulting; (2) senior leadership together at least three years; (3) no subcontracting account management, and all responsible personnel are employees; (4) currently consulting for at least five public pension funds each over $1.5bn; (5) primary consultant has at least five years of defined-benefit public-pension consulting and at least three years employed by proposer; (6) fiduciary service to MERF/OPEB and written compliance with their investment policies/guidelines; (7) no existing or potential material conflicts with the City Treasurer/staff, Pension Commission, OPEB Committee, actuary, auditor, managers or other providers; (8) agree to execute a contract similar to AppendixE; (9) current SEC investment-adviser registration; (10) carry or have applied by submission for general liability $5m, E&O/professional liability $5m, fiduciary liability $1m, workers' compensation/employer liability $1m, and cybersecurity $1m. Section2 says all qualifications must be met by March15,2024 at 5pm ET and AppendixA certification must be completed. AppendixA separately uses different client-threshold/history and insurance-date wording; this answer follows Section2 as asked.
